run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the longest strict bitonic subsequence length for an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which calculates longest strict bitonic subsequence using forward and backward passes
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that uses dictionary-based tracking for increasing and decreasing subsequence lengths
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the dictionary-based approach with a standard dynamic programming solution
